en.biography: I am an Associate Professor and PhD supervisor at the Institute of Artificial Intelligence, Xiamen University, a jointly appointed Associate Researcher at Peng Cheng Laboratory, and an IEEE Senior Member. I received my PhD from Xiamen University, advised by Prof. Rongrong Ji, and was a postdoctoral researcher at Peng Cheng Laboratory from 2022 to 2023, working with Prof. Yonghong Tian. My research focuses on automated machine learning, neural architecture search, model compression and efficient large-model deployment. I have published 25 CCF-A papers as first or corresponding author. I lead an NSFC General Program project and multiple industry-sponsored projects with partners including Huawei and HiSilicon. The resulting technologies have been applied to products at Huawei, HiSilicon, Tencent, Alibaba/Tmall, HONOR, vivo, OPPO and DiDi. I have received support from the Postdoctoral Innovative Talent Support Program, the China Postdoctoral Science Foundation and the Xiamen University Xiaomi Young Scholar Program, and collaborate on open-source research including MetaGPT with Jürgen Schmidhuber. I previously served on secondment in the Software Division of the Xiamen Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology, contributing to AI innovation-center planning, industry development and policy materials. I teach Algorithm Design and Analysis and Art and Technology.

en.service:
• Associate Editor, Pattern Recognition (March 2026–December 2029).

  • Area Chair: NeurIPS 2025, ICLR 2026 and PRCV 2025; accepted Area Chair appointments for ICLR 2027 and AAAI 2027.

  • ICML 2026 Silver Reviewer; ICLR 2025 Notable Reviewer.

  • Conference reviewing and program committee service includes CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, ICML, ICLR, NeurIPS, AAAI, ACM Multimedia and ACL Rolling Review.

  • Journal reviewing includes IEEE TPAMI, IJCV, IEEE TIP, IEEE TMM, IEEE MultiMedia, IEEE TCDS, ACM TOSEM, Engineering, Knowledge-Based Systems and Pattern Recognition; accepted a TMLR reviewer invitation.

  • Standardization contributions include GB/T 42382.1-2023 and the IEEE 2941 series. I received an IEEE SA Certificate of Appreciation for contributions to standardization; the IEEE 2941 working group in which I participated received the 2022 IEEE SA Emerging Technology Award.

  • Contributor to the 2024 Xiamen Science and Technology Progress Award (First Prize) and the 2025 Ministry of Education Engineering Technology Research Achievement Award (Second Prize).

  • Member of the Artificial Intelligence subcommittee of the Fourth National Committee for Computer Science and Technology Terminology.

zh.biography: 郑侠武，厦门大学人工智能研究院副教授、博士生导师，鹏城实验室双聘副研究员，IEEE Senior Member。获厦门大学计算机科学与技术博士学位，师从纪荣嵘教授；2022年至2023年在鹏城实验室从事博士后研究，合作导师为田永鸿教授。主要研究自动机器学习、神经网络结构搜索、模型压缩与大模型高效部署。以第一作者或通讯作者在CCF-A类期刊和会议发表论文25篇。主持国家自然科学基金面上项目及华为、海思等多项横向项目，相关技术应用于华为、海思、腾讯、阿里／天猫、荣耀、vivo、OPPO和滴滴等企业产品。曾获博士后创新人才支持计划、中国博士后科学基金面上资助，并获选厦门大学小米青年学者项目；参与MetaGPT等开源研究，与Jürgen Schmidhuber合作。曾担任厦门市工业和信息化局软件处挂职干部，参与人工智能创新中心建设、产业发展规划及政策材料工作。承担本科《算法设计与分析A》和研究生《艺术与科技》课程教学。

• Pattern Recognition 副编辑，任期2026年3月至2029年12月。

  • 领域主席：NeurIPS 2025、ICLR 2026、PRCV 2025；已接受 ICLR 2027、AAAI 2027 领域主席任职。

  • ICML 2026 Silver Reviewer、ICLR 2025 Notable Reviewer。
